title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Emergency Fund Guide

title: Emergency Fund Guide Beginner FAQ
summary: Straight answers to the most common emergency fund guide questions.
body:
Q: 3 or 6 months?
A: 3 if stable job + dual income; 6 if freelance or single income.

Q: Where to keep it?
A: High-yield savings - liquid, separate, earning.

Q: What counts as emergency?
A: Job loss, medical bills, essential car/home repair. Not sales.

Still stuck? Start with record 2 of this guide and do the first move today.
